messages:
alex (release-council): deploybot auto-paused ap-south rollouts after the network flap. holding the rest of the window.
maya (sre): confirmed packet loss on a subset of nodes. curious if we have any failing canaries or just elevated error budget.
deploybot: deploybot: Paused 7 scheduled rollouts in env=ap-south. Reason: incident-2025-06-ap-net-flap.
jin (platform): quick ask: do we want to roll back canaries that are showing 5xx, or pin and do a mini-rollback only for the failing service?
carla (product): product preference is minimal churn. prefer targeted mini-rollback for the single noisy service instead of global rollback. CS wants a concise line for impacted releases.
maya (sre): fine with targeted mini-rollback for the noisy service (search-indexer). global rollbacks are risky due to cache re-warm.
alex (release-council): ok decision: pin all canaries, unpromoted. allow a manual mini-rollback for search-indexer only, scoped to blue lane, and require 2 approvals.
maya (sre): creating the pin + mini-rollback guard now.
```
# pin everything and enable mini rollback guard
releasectl pin --env ap-south --group '*' --reason "incident-2025-06-ap-net-flap"
releasectl set-policy --env ap-south --group search-indexer --policy mini-rollback --scope blue --approvals 2
```

maya (sre): pins applied; mini-rollback policy set id=mr-301.
deploybot: Policy updated: env=ap-south mode=hold, mini-rollback=enabled for search-indexer, approvals_required=2.
jin (platform): requeue non-urgent releases to next-window:evening-utc and annotate with incident tag. leave any P0 patches to manual approval path.
alex (release-council): requeue command incoming.
```
releasectl requeue --env ap-south --priority low --target-window evening-utc --note "requeued due to ap-net-flap; search-indexer mini-rollback allowed"
```

deploybot: 4 releases requeued -> evening-utc. 2 releases marked P0 and held for manual triage.
carla (product): CS blurb: "Deployments in AP region delayed due to transient networking incident. Targeted rollback allowed for affected service. We'll update if the window moves."
maya (sre): for the mini-rollback: please request approvals here when ready. if within 20m metrics don't improve, we escalate to full freeze + emergency rollback.
jin (platform): requested manual approval flow enabled; add perf-smoke gate and two approvers: maya + jin.

```
# manual rollback exec (example)
releasectl rollback --env ap-south --group search-indexer --to-version 2025.06.10-stable --lane blue --manual-approval id=mr-301
```

alex (release-council): noted. I'll prep the brief post-incident release note and attach to requeued releases.
ops-bot: Alert: packet-loss normalized at 1795550075 in ap-south-1 cluster. monitoring continues.
maya (sre): seeing error budget trending down but recovering. keeping watch for 30m.
alex (release-council): thanks team. marking thread as incident-triggered hold + targeted rollback plan. will follow up with a short after-action once incident closes. :white_check_mark:
